# Baishideng Publishing Group (WJGNET)

> > A comprehensive open-access academic publishing platform hosting 47 peer-reviewed medical and life science journals with global editorial and reviewer networks.

Baishideng Publishing Group (BPG) operates through WJGNET as a leading open-access publisher of high-quality medical research. The platform serves researchers, clinicians, and academics worldwide through its advanced search infrastructure, peer-review systems, and publishing analytics.

## Key Topics

## Core Platform

- [WJGNET Homepage](https://www.wjgnet.com): Main portal for BPG's 47 peer-reviewed open-access medical and life science journals with access to global research content
- [Advanced Search](https://www.wjgnet.com/advancedsearch): Comprehensive search interface for discovering articles across BPG's entire journal database with filtering and publication search capabilities

## Publishing Analytics & Statistics

- [Member Statistics](https://www.wjgnet.com/bpg/MemberStatistics): Publishing metrics and analytics for editorial board members with global distribution data and visitor statistics
- [Senior Scholar Statistics](https://www.wjgnet.com/bpg/SeniorScholarStatistics): Performance data for senior scholars and peer reviewers including geographic distribution across major publishing regions
